scope: Historical measurements transcribed from the user-supplied 3D hand reconstruction report; not new inference or a unified benchmark.

hand_sequence.caution: The report does not provide the full coordinate alignment and filtering protocol. Do not conflate valid-comparison coverage with whole-dataset accuracy.

depth_case.caution: Rounded values from the original figure, not recomputed joint arrays.

camera_sequence.caution: Sim(3) fits scale to GT. This is not the production HaWoR-SLAM path or a multi-GPU throughput benchmark.

stereo_comparison.caution: WiLoR full + 2D/3D window MANO fitting, not stereo_hawor. Exact common-frame evaluation protocol is not supplied.
